title: Talking Tom and Friends
description:
S1
Armed with tech gear, ideas and an unfailing sense of humor, Talking Tom and his friends are on a mission to reach stardom at all costs.

title: Talking Tom and Friends
description:
S1 E26 — The Perfect Day
Ben's simulator app makes Tom's fantasies come true; he realizes only Angela can perfect his day.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E11 — Fairies in the Spring
After the king decides to build a water park, so his subjects can cool off in summer heat, water monsters attack the construction crew.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E13 — The Moblins Are Revolting
Ganon demonstrates a new wand that makes a bubble around its victim that can only be popped by the Triforce of Power; fed up with Ganon's orders, a Moblin uses the wand to trap Ganon in a bubble and throws him down a bottomless pit.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E1 — The Ringer
Link's only consolation for the boring duty of guarding the Triforce of Wisdom is keeping company with Princess Zelda, who does not feel the same way.

title: Totally Spies!
description:
S1 E19 — Game Girls
A villain invents a device which literally captures extreme sports stars and places them into an extreme video game; Alex falls for a teen idol who turns out to be a computer-generated personality.

title: Totally Spies
description:
S1 E17 — Spy vs. Spy
The spies are replaced by three former spies who have decided to come out of retirement.

title: Totally Spies!
description:
S1 E24 — Do You Believe in Magic
The spies go after an art thief and find that all of their leads point to a supposedly deceased magician.

title: Atomic Betty
description:
S1 E2 — But the Cat Came Back!; Lost in Spa
Purrsy messes up Betty's room; Maximus captures Admiral DeGill.

title: Atomic Betty
description:
S1 E3 — Spindly Tarn Kanushu; Science Fair
Maximus captures Betty's martial arts trainer; Betty participates in the school science fair.

title: Atomic Betty
description:
S1 — The Furball for the Sneeze; Attack of the Evil Baby
When the galaxy beckons, Betty becomes Galactic Guardian and Defender of the Cosmos.

title: Rabbids Invasion
description:
S1 E23 — Keypad Rabbids
A Rabbid walks down the street and steps on some chewing gum; when he realizes that he is stuck, he manages to free himself and ends up rolling under a portico and through a large door that is just closing.

title: Rabbids Invasion
description:
S1 E25 — Schnoz Rabbid
A Rabbid sticks a fake nose on his face that changes the sound of his voice; the other Rabbids are completely amazed; the leader is jealous and tries to regain his position by using accessories to impress the Rabbids.

title: Rabbids Invasion
description:
S1 E28 — Never Refreeze a Rabbid
The Rabbids try desperately to get frozen food boxes out of a grocery store freezer.

title: Talking Tom and Friends
description:
S1 E28 — Ghost Pirate Hunting
Hank and Ginger touch Ben's computer without permission; a scary pirate ghost appears.

title: Talking Tom and Friends
description:
S1 E31 — Lost Friend Will Zee
Talking Tom's long-lost childhood pal Will Zee comes crashing in for a visit; but Tom is thrown for a loop when Will turns out to be way cooler than the bed-wetter he remembers from summer camp.

title: Talking Tom and Friends
description:
S1 E32 — Angela's Secret
Talking Tom knows that Talking Angela is a health nut, but that doesn't explain the amount of fruit in her house; convinced she's gone bananas, he eats.

title: Angry Birds
description:
S1
Red and his fearless bird friends must find a way to protect their precious eggs from the Bad Piggies and their relentless assault.

title: Angry Birds
description:
S3 E3 — Golditrotters
This little pig is too tough for a dumb children's book.

title: The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3
description:
S1 E10 — Crimes R Us; Life's Ruff
King Koopa helps an infamous criminal; King Windbag's magic wand is stolen.

title: The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3
description:
S1 — Up, Up and a Koopa
The Mushroom Kingdom is sent into the sky.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E2 — Cold Spells
The first days of spring mark spring-cleaning at Hyrule Castle; Link fakes a cold to avoid chores; Ganon infiltrates the castle and, to create a distraction, covertly augments Sprite's magical powers as she too performs cleaning chores.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E4 — Kiss 'N' Tell
A damsel in distress from a dragon refuses help from Princess Zelda, but after being saved by Link, the lady rewards her hero with a kiss that turns him into a frog.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E5 — Sing for the Unicorn
Link plans an attempt at romancing Zelda by swinging into her window from above by a rope; the attempt is interrupted as Ganon rides a flying unicorn over the castle and kidnaps the king for ransom.

title: Totally Spies!
description:
S1 E23 — Malled
A sinister store is abducting shoppers and turning them into anti-consumers across the world.

title: Totally Spies!
description:
S1 E22 — Soul Collector
The spies battle a villain who is stealing souls from the youth of America.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description:

Skeletor tries to banish Evil-Lyn to another dimension for betraying him in favor of the Snake Men.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description:
S2 E7 — Of Machines and Men
A mysterious force disables all technological power in Eternia.

title: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures
description:
S2 E2 — Meanie Genie
Pac is tricked into finding a bottle holding a genie, who promises to grant his every wish.

title: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures
description:
S2 E3 — Cave PAC-MAN
Dr. Buttocks gets himself into another sticky situation by defrosting a prehistoric Cave-Kid.

Betty must sell candy door-to-door; Sparky dismantles the ship.

Humans are lost in the Mushroom Kingdom; the brothers enter an underwater kingdom.
